# C1: Catalog records

A catalog describes an ecosystem as records. Each record is one YAML file at `catalog/generated/<kind>/<id>.yaml` (written by scans) or `catalog/curated/curateddecision/<id>.yaml` (decisions people make over generated records). Files are written in canonical form: keys in a fixed order, list defaults written out, so the same facts always give the same bytes.

Every record has the common fields below, then the fields of its kind. Readers accept every supported schema version and writers always write the current one.

Specification version 0.1.0.

| Version                 | Value |
| ----------------------- | ----- |
| Schema version          | 2     |
| Versions readers accept | 1, 2  |

## Common fields

Every record kind has these fields.

| Field                  | Type                   | Required | Values                                                                                                                                    | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `kind`                 | string                 | yes      |                                                                                                                                           | The record's kind: one of the kinds below.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `schemaVersion`        | 1 or 2 (SchemaVersion) | yes      | `1`, `2`                                                                                                                                  | A record's schema version. Version-1 files differ from version 2 only in this number, so they are read as they are and come back as version 2 in memory; writers always write the current version, and `migrateCatalog` rewrites old files. The type stays `1 \| 2` so code that builds version-1 records in memory keeps compiling until it is updated. |
| `id`                   | string (RecordId)      | yes      |                                                                                                                                           | Stable record id. Lowercase slug, safe as a file name on Linux, macOS and Windows (no ":" or "/"), so every record can live in its own file named by its id.                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `status`               | enum (Status)          | yes      | `current`, `planned-new`, `planned-modify`, `planned-retire`, `retired`                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `confidence`           | enum (Confidence)      | yes      | `verified`, `inferred`, `asserted`                                                                                                        | verified: read directly from code, config or a published spec (an interface needs both ends seen). inferred: one end only, a diagram, a document or a rule. asserted: stated or confirmed by a person. Documents are never "asserted".                                                                                                                   |
| `evidence`             | object[]               | yes      |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].source`    | enum (EvidenceSource)  | yes      | `code`, `config`, `spec`, `gateway`, `event-config`, `infrastructure`, `pipeline`, `migration`, `diagram`, `document`, `export`, `manual` |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].repo`      | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].path`      | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].line`      | integer                | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].commit`    | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].scannedAt` | string (datetime)      | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].extractor` | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           | "name@version" of the extractor that produced this evidence.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `evidence[].dialect`   | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           | "name@version" of the dialect applied, if any.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `evidence[].side`      | enum                   | no       | `caller`, `callee`, `gateway`, `definition`, `document`                                                                                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `evidence[].by`        | string                 | no       |                                                                                                                                           | For manual evidence: who stated it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `flags`                | string[]               | no       |                                                                                                                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Documented values

`Component.type` and `DataStore.storeType` are free text, so an ecosystem can name a shape the specification doesn't list; these values are the documented ones, and tools treat them as known.

- Component types: `service`, `spa`, `bff`, `mobile-app`, `desktop-app`, `function`, `batch-job`, `data-pipeline`, `ml-model`, `gateway`, `worker`, `library`, `mainframe-program`.
- Data store types: `relational`, `document`, `key-value`, `cache`, `warehouse`, `lake`, `object-storage`, `search`, `feature-store`, `queue`, `stream`, `file-share`.
- System tags: `saas` marks a SaaS product used as a system (boundary `vendor`).

## Capability

A feature (ADR 0031): what a set of entry points and the records their flows span add up to. Detected from code on every scan (`namedBy: detected`, confidence `inferred`), named by an AI proposal (`ai`, still `inferred`) or confirmed by a person (`person`, `asserted` through a curated decision). Ids are `feature.<slug>` of the primary resource.

| Field                   | Type                | Required | Values                                     | Description                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `name`                  | string              | yes      |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `description`           | string              | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `entryPoints`           | string (RecordId)[] | no       |                                            | Where the feature starts: UI routes, public or gateway endpoints, jobs, event consumers. |
| `records`               | string (RecordId)[] | no       |                                            | Everything its flows reach: components, endpoints, interfaces, topics, tables.           |
| `owner`                 | string              | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `tags`                  | string[]            | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `externalRefs`          | object[]            | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `externalRefs[].system` | enum                | yes      | `ado`, `jira`, `wiki`, `openspec`, `other` |                                                                                          |
| `externalRefs[].id`     | string              | yes      |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `externalRefs[].url`    | string              | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `externalRefs[].title`  | string              | no       |                                            |                                                                                          |
| `namedBy`               | enum                | yes      | `detected`, `ai`, `person`                 |                                                                                          |
